    ∃ (S : FGModuleCat R), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable S ∧ (∃ (f : S ⟶ restrictObj k F R B), f ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ (T : FGModuleCat R), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable T → (∃ (f : T ⟶ restrictObj k F R B), f ≠ 0) → Nonempty (T ≅ S)

    The ground isomorphism class associated to a stable extension module is characterized by admitting a nonzero map into the restriction.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.same_ground_class_iff_galois_conjugate (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [IsGalois k F] (P : TwoTerm R) {X Y : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)} {S T : FGModuleCat R} (hx : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable X) (hy : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable Y) (hs : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable S) (ht : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable T) (f : S ⟶ restrictObj k F R X) (hf : f ≠ 0) (g : T ⟶ restrictObj k F R Y) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (S ≅ T) ↔ ∃ (σ : Gal(F/k)) (v : restrictObj k F R X ⟶ restrictObj k F R Y), IsGaloisHom k F R σ v ∧ Function.Bijective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom v.hom)

    On stable extension modules, equality of the associated ground class is exactly Galois conjugacy.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.finite_galois_stable_correspondence (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [IsGalois k F] (P : TwoTerm R) :
    let ExtStable := { B : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R) // (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable B }; let GroundStable := { c : CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R) // (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj c) }; ∃ (φ : ExtStable → GroundStable), Function.Surjective φ ∧ (∀ (B : ExtStable), ∃ (l : (CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj ↑(φ B) ⟶ restrictObj k F R ↑B), l ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ (B C : ExtStable), φ B = φ C ↔ ∃ (σ : Gal(F/k)) (v : restrictObj k F R ↑B ⟶ restrictObj k F R ↑C), IsGaloisHom k F R σ v ∧ Function.Bijective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom v.hom)

    Over a finite Galois extension, stable extension modules map onto the ground stable isomorphism classes, with fibres exactly the Galois orbits. The class of a module is the unique stable ground subobject of its restriction up to isomorphism.
